name: Rosneft
note: General sponsor of HC CSKA Moscow (club partners page) and main sponsor of HC Salavat Yulaev per Sport-Express (2026-04-21: 1.5bn RUB of 2026 financing unpaid since January). Owner chain: state-owned JSC Rosneftegaz holds 40.40% of Rosneft (register footnote: 100% federal ownership). Tier proposal: concern — the Russian state, whose war in Ukraine is documented, holds ~40% of the sponsor through Rosneftegaz; control (>50%, golden share, board seat) is not sourced, so concern rather than serious. A maintainer sets the tier.
